Sensible heat flux

Source: R/metric-sensible-heat.R
ef_sensible_heat.Rd

Computes the sensible heat flux \(H\) [W m-2] from the air density, the near-surface temperature difference and the aerodynamic resistance to heat transport (bulk transfer equation of METRIC).

Usage

ef_sensible_heat(air_density, dt, rah, cp = EF_SPECIFIC_HEAT_AIR)

Arguments

air_density

Numeric. Air density [kg m-3] (see ef_air_density()). Must be finite and > 0.

dt

Numeric. Near-surface temperature difference \(dT\) [K] (from \(dT = a + b\,T_{s,datum}\)). Must be finite; negative values are allowed.

rah

Numeric. Aerodynamic resistance to heat transport [s m-1] (see ef_rah()). Must be finite and > 0.

cp

Numeric. Specific heat of air at constant pressure [J kg-1 K-1]. Must be finite and > 0. Default 1004 J kg-1 K-1 (the package constant EF_SPECIFIC_HEAT_AIR; Waters et al., 2002, p. 25, text of Eq. 25; decision SH-09), the value used and recorded by ef_calibrate_h() (element constants$cp); FAO-56 uses 1013 J kg-1 K-1.

Value

A numeric vector of sensible heat flux \(H\) [W m-2], with the common length of the inputs and keeping their dim. Negative values (\(dT < 0\), e.g. advection) are physically possible and are returned unchanged.

Details

$$H = \frac{\rho_{air}\, c_p\, dT}{r_{ah}}$$

Within the METRIC calibration, \(dT\) at the anchors is proportional to \(1/c_p\), so that, for a given \(r_{ah}\), the sensible heat flux of a pixel does not depend on \(c_p\); it enters only through the Monin-Obukhov length (dev/specs/sensible-heat.md section 8.3).

Missing values propagate. Infinite values and values outside the domain raise an error of class earthflux_domain_error (also earthflux_input_error).

Verification status: VERIFICADA (SEBAL-Idaho 2002): Waters et al. (2002), p. 25, Eq. 25, with \(c_p\) = 1004 J kg-1 K-1. The cross-check with Allen et al. (2007) remains desirable but is no longer blocking.

References

Allen, R. G., Tasumi, M., & Trezza, R. (2007). Satellite-based energy balance for mapping evapotranspiration with internalized calibration (METRIC) - Model. Journal of Irrigation and Drainage Engineering, 133(4), 380-394. doi:10.1061/(ASCE)0733-9437(2007)133:4(380)

Waters, R., Allen, R., Bastiaanssen, W., Tasumi, M., & Trezza, R. (2002). SEBAL: Surface Energy Balance Algorithms for Land. Idaho implementation. Advanced training and users manual (Version 1.0). University of Idaho and Idaho Department of Water Resources.

See also

Other aerodynamics and sensible heat functions: ef_air_density(), ef_blending_wind(), ef_calibrate_h(), ef_dt_coef(), ef_h_control(), ef_rah(), ef_ts_datum(), ef_ustar(), ef_zom()

Examples

ef_sensible_heat(air_density = 1.069979, dt = 5.789273, rah = 28.1850)
#> [1] 220.6556
